title: Expression safety
statement: Given resource limits and a state, an expression is safe if it satisfies the following recursive conditions. A constant is safe when its value is at most the integer word bound, and every variable is safe. A binary operation is safe when both subexpressions are safe and the absolute value of their result is at most the word bound; a load is safe when its address expression is safe and evaluates to a valid address.
